licence.name: GPL-3.0-only
licence.source: The repository LICENSE is the GPLv3 text and the list header points to it, with no "or later", so CPAB treats the list as GPL-3.0-only. The same licence ships as LICENSE at the top of the package.

checks.licenceStated: The list header "License:" points to https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/blob/master/LICENSE. That file was read on 2026-11-07: it is the GPLv3 text, in the FSF's older template.
checks.licenceAccepted: GPL-3.0 is on the accepted set, only or later.
checks.notRefused: No NonCommercial or NoDerivatives term, nothing forbids redistribution or restricts the audience.
checks.attribution: uBlock Origin (https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets), shown in settings and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
checks.aggregated: Not an aggregate: curated by hand in uAssets, with the sources for each entry in the comments above it. The file has no !#include line.
checks.ownFile: The converted rules are one file of their own, never merged with another list, under GPL-3.0-only. The GPLv3 text is in the package as LICENSE.
checks.retrievable: A stable repository. The snapshot is fetched at the last commit that changed filters/badware.txt and records that commit and its SHA-256; the file has no Version line.
